<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows a single distinct upfield carbon signal at 19.40 ppm, which is characteristic of a methyl (CH₃) carbon. No other carbon signals appear in the typical methyl region (≈10–30 ppm). Therefore, the molecule contains one type of methyl carbon, corresponding to a single methyl group.</thought>
